title: Freshly prove or repair Main Display density, weather slots, and preset glow
verify: Start from the current worktree baseline and, before any production or test behavior write, run a fresh W30 task-specific RED probe at exactly 2460x1080 and 1280x720. The probe must record the complete HH:mm bounds and available central/upper region, all four weather-slot bounds/order for NO_DATA, partial and populated redacted-fixture states, and the three preset visual receipts. Do not reuse W26, W28 or W29 evidence as W30 RED/GREEN; those records are provenance context only.

If the current baseline is already claim-equivalent GREEN for every W30 claim, record RED_NOT_APPLICABLE with the explicit accepted reason that intentionally breaking an already accepted display would falsify the behavior and manufacture a failure; prove that result with fresh W30 receipts at both sizes and all three fixture states, and make no production/test behavior write. Otherwise retain the fresh RED and apply only the exact two-file boundary.

When a correction is required, change only DisplayCapability.kt with focused DisplayProjectionTest.kt support: keep the full HH:mm unclipped in the available central/upper area at both sizes; keep all four yesterday/today/tomorrow/day_after shells stable and ordered for NO_DATA, partial and populated redacted data; and render each existing circular preset with a one-color preset radial shade gradient, a materially wider rim than the fresh W30 RED and three static outward-fading glow layers.

Obtain claim-equivalent GREEN from the same fresh W30 host path and distinguish the complete clock string/bounds, four-slot state matrix and preset receipts. GREEN must show no clipping/overflow, no slot disappearance or layout shift, no fabricated weather values, one preset-color radial gradient, the wider rim and exactly three static fading glow layers without obscuring clock/cards.

Preserve Main Display ownership, all preset order/labels/existing colors/selected-active styling/touch routing, the existing Main Display -> Weather Context read-only provider boundary, and Timer & Alert lifecycle/countdown/cancellation/overdue/audio semantics. Do not modify WeatherCapability, providers/adapters, refresh/freshness/cache/history/normalized data, Settings, lifecycle owners or runtime wiring.

Apply a named Reviewer/visual-QA rubric to fresh W30 receipts at both sizes, recording PASS/FAIL and decisive observations for full-clock readability, no clipping/overflow, four-slot NO_DATA/partial/populated stability, one-color radial treatment, wider rim, three static glow layers, lightweight rendering and honest host/device separation. The rubric is evidence, not a T3 checkpoint.

Run the focused display suite, full host suite, clean build, lint and diff gates only during the later execution/verification route. Keep Samsung GT-I9300I Android 11 custom-ROM, target 1280x720, fullscreen, keep-screen-on, physical readability and runtime visual evidence DEFERRED unless separately authorized; do not launch emulator/device/runtime, use adb, network or credentials.

Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-001 if fitting, the one-color radial shade, materially wider rim or three-layer fading glow requires a new fixed dp/ratio/font/gradient-stop/product visual target. Stop and route to /spec-design if ownership, provider/touch/lifecycle boundary, module, graph edge, public contract, dependency, resource pipeline or composition-root orchestration must change. Stop on any write outside the two exact files or any W29/W28/history/checkpoint/status/terminal-state mutation.

constraints: Main Display is the sole owner of shell composition/presentation and consumes existing projections without writing neighbor state; no business orchestration belongs in MainActivity, FoundationRuntime or a generic helper.

REQ-001 constrains the existing landscape/fullscreen policy, REQ-002 governs the dominant clock/four-slot/preset composition, REQ-005 is a read-only Weather projection regression, and REQ-023 governs material readability/lightweight visual proof; no new AC or RTM lifecycle value is created.

The four slots remain yesterday/today/tomorrow/day_after and remain present in NO_DATA, partial and populated redacted-fixture cases. Main Display may render stable shells and existing read-model values but may not synthesize data or alter Weather Context availability/freshness/provider semantics.

Timer & Alert remains the sole owner of preset execution, countdown, cancellation, overdue, audio and lifecycle semantics. Weather Context/provider remains the sole owner of normalized data, cache/history, refresh, freshness, availability and weather-specific presentation semantics.

Only existing Android/project-native primitives and host fixtures are authorized. No resource/asset/dependency/public-contract/graph-edge/event/network/credential/target-runtime side effect is authorized.
